name: kaiming-he
tagline_zh: 调参调到头秃？让 ResNet 之父的推理风格接管你的网络设计。从残差到流匹配，像凯明一样直击本质，少走弯路。
tagline_en: Stuck tuning? Let the ResNet creator's reasoning style take over your architecture design. From residuals to flow.
desc_en: Applies the reasoning style of Kaiming He, computer vision pioneer and creator of ResNet. Use this skill whenever you are designing deep learning architectures, debugging neural network optimization, formulating generative AI problems, or bridging AI with other scientific domains. Trigger this skill for discussions on network depth, weight initialization, residual learning, flow matching, or when
why_zh: 不是套话，而是把凯明论文里的决策逻辑提炼成可操作的推理步骤，专治深度学习中的模糊地带。
why_en: Distills Kaiming's paper decision logic into actionable reasoning steps, targeting the fuzzy zones of deep learning.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 同类聚簇审查（把 X 变成 skill（造 skill 工厂））。同上：同一生成器 output/ 目录里的第二件，与 karpathy 那件同域（都触发于 designing deep learning architectures / debugging neural networks），骨架逐字相同。两件的差异只有人名和被填进模板的内容，说不清「为什么是这两位、不是 output/ 里另外 20 位」。 正文原话：description: Applies the reasoning style of Kaiming He … Use this skill whenever you are designing deep learning architectures, debugging neural network optimization…（对照 karpathy 件：Applies the mental models and frameworks of Andrej Karpathy … whenever you are helping the user build neural networks from scratch, debug deep learning pipelines）
